findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a repo uses Claude workers while Codex remains its review tool.
With tools = "both", workers = "claude", and an installed but signed-out Codex, on_codex is false and this check never runs. However, src/forge/review.py:910–914 selects installed Codex for reviews regardless of workers, so close still needs its sign-in. The same omission occurs when an item's Claude override replaces a split worker setting at doctor.py:337–339. Doctor therefore omits the promised warning and codex login advice. Include review routing when deciding whether Codex is needed, and correct tests/test_init_uses_signed_in_tools.py:52, which currently expects no warning for this configuration.
